description: This file defines a thread-safe implementation of a fixed-size, circular FIFO queue that automatically evicts the oldest element when full. It includes custom iterator support and synchronization mechanisms, and is part of the org.openmrs.util package.

classes.name: ThreadSafeCircularFifoQueue
classes.description: A thread-safe, fixed-size circular FIFO queue with evicting behavior when full, supporting iteration and concurrent modifications.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an element to the queue, evicting the oldest if full.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds all elements from a collection to the queue.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all elements from the queue.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if an object exists in the queue.

methods.name: containsAll
methods.description: Checks if all elements of a collection are in the queue.

methods.name: element
methods.description: Retrieves, but does not remove, the head of the queue.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the elements in the queue.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: offer
methods.description: Offers an element to the queue (same as add).

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Returns the head of the queue without removing it.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the head of the queue, or null if empty.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes and returns the head of the queue.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific object from the queue if present.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all elements from the queue that are in the given collection.

methods.name: retainAll
methods.description: Retains only the elements in the queue that are contained in the specified collection.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the queue.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array containing all of the elements in the queue.

methods.name: <T> toArray
methods.description: Returns an array containing all of the elements in the queue in the runtime type of the specified array.
